prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: large responsive wedding invitation section background material
Primary request: Create a high-resolution luminous pearl-blush pressed paper surface matching the refined paper leaves in Image 1, isolated as a reusable background.
Input images: Image 1 is a paper color, fiber, emboss depth, and heirloom craft reference only; do not reproduce its layout, wording, numerals, schedule, venue drawing, ribbon, hardware, borders, or controls.
Scene/backdrop: no scene; the canvas itself is a perfectly top-down paper sheet filling the image edge to edge.
Subject: warm pearl-blush cotton paper with visible fine fibers, gentle cloudy tonal variation, and sparse blind-embossed botanical stems entering only from the outer edges and corners; the broad central 65 percent stays visually quiet for semantic text.
Style/medium: photorealistic luxury pressed stationery material, tactile handmade paper, deckled fiber character, sculpted but restrained embossing.
Composition/framing: wide landscape material plate with generous crop safety, flat orthographic view, no perspective, no separate card outline and no baked-in border; edge botanicals are large enough to remain obvious after downscaling but never invade the center.
Lighting/mood: soft even pearl illumination with shallow grazing light that reveals the pressed grain and botanical relief, no hotspot or dramatic cast shadow.
Color palette: pearl blush averaging #D1BEB4 with ivory highlights, warm taupe fiber shadows, extremely subtle muted mauve undertone.
Materials/textures: visible cotton fibers, fine pressed grain, shallow blind emboss with clearly readable raised edges, softly deckled character at the outermost crop.
Constraints: seamless-enough for background cover cropping; no ink, no writing, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no frame, no ribbon, no seal, no people, no hands.
Avoid: blank flat beige, watercolor wash, marble, parchment stains, aged yellow paper, torn central holes, floral print, lace, glitter, metallic foil, gray office paper, heavy vignette.
